dialect.detail: VAX/VMS COBOL (DEC VAX-8530), likely VAX COBOL compiler. Uses WHEN FALSE clause in 88-level conditions (COBOL-85 extension), DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA, SORT with INPUT/OUTPUT PROCEDURE, RELEASE/RETURN verbs, indexed file with ALTERNATE RECORD KEY.
evidence: ASSIGN TO DISK / ASSIGN TO SORT

purpose.domain_detail: Vehicle rental (alquileres) management system - likely a university project (UPR installation comment). Processes rental records sorted by date, driver, and client.
purpose.summary: This program reads an indexed file of rental records (ALQUILERES), sorts them by date, driver, client, status, and license plate using an internal sort, then processes the sorted output by evaluating each record's status (Rejected, Terminated, or To-Process). It appears to be a student exercise for a rental/taxi fleet management system.

notable_features: SORT with INPUT PROCEDURE / OUTPUT PROCEDURE
Indexed file with ALTERNATE RECORD KEY WITH DUPLICATES
DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA (European/Latin American numeric format)
88-level conditions with WHEN FALSE clause (DEC VAX COBOL extension)
Anonymous 01-level items used as boolean flags
DATE-WRITTEN in Spanish (4 DE FEBRERO DE 1992)
verdict.notes: Written in 1992 for a VAX-8530 system, likely a university assignment (INSTALLATION comment references UPR - possibly Universidad de Puerto Rico or similar). The program is incomplete/skeletal - the SALIDA output procedure only partially processes records with DISPLAY statements and no actual report generation despite working-storage having page/line counters and total accumulators. Contains a tab character in the source causing a long line. The WHEN FALSE extension on 88-level items is a DEC VAX COBOL feature not in standard COBOL-85.
